# Benchmark dependencies

Flatbush 4.7.0 and FlatQueue 3.1.0 are used only to reproduce the packed R-tree comparison. Each project’s ISC license is included alongside its code. Both source files are from the release tag. The only source change is the Flatbush import path pointing to the adjacent FlatQueue module.

- [Flatbush v4.7.0](https://github.com/mourner/flatbush/tree/v4.7.0)
- [FlatQueue v3.1.0](https://github.com/mourner/flatqueue/tree/v3.1.0)
